# Ecologi

Ecologi is the platform for collective climate action. Purchase trees and carbon offsets programmatically through their Impact API.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ecologi/.

## Actions

- **Get User Carbon Offset** (read-only): Get the total tonnes of CO2e emissions a user has avoided (carbon offset).
- **Get User Carbon Removal** (read-only): Retrieve the total tonnes of CO₂e a user has permanently removed from the atmosphere.
- **Get User Habitat Restoration** (read-only): Get the total area of habitat and ecosystem a user has restored.
- **Get User Impact** (read-only): Get a combination of all impact types a user has funded.
- **Get User Trees** (read-only): Get the total number of trees a user has funded on Ecologi.
